The '''New Republic Special Acquisitions Unit''' was a special unit of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] formed to capture the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']]. Headed by [[Cryle Cavv]], the unit's only other member was [[Sienn Sconn]]. After the successful capture of the ''Guardian'', Cavv retired and Sconn resigned from the unit.<ref name="TFO" />
